data <- table (map.values)
y <- data[,1]

and getting this error:
There were R errors, showing 30:

however when i use the same code on a local file (not on hdfs) it works fine...

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] loading table from RData file in mapper

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] loading table from RData file in mapper
parts:
This will not work. You input folder is Rdata files? What you're thinking of MultilFileInputFormat which
RHIPE does not support (maybe in future).

I recommend you upgrade to 0.72.1

You have two options,
a) use rhls(input folder) to see how many rdata files you have, say L
then rhwatch(, input=c(L, K))

K is a level of parallelism.

Each mapper will get a number from 1 to L. Use system("hadoop dfs -get path-to-i'thRdata file ./")
and then do load("ith Rdata file"). So map.values will be a  subset of 1 to L

b) instead of saving Rdata via rhsave, save your text files to the HDFS using rhcollect(someindex, data). Of course you probably still
have many text files? Then each file will be one map task. Save the entire file (like you're doing) and instead write using rhcollect(filename, data)
using sequence as the output format.

and use 0.72.1. 0.69 wont be supported.
https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/blob/master/code/Rhipe_0.72.1.tar.gz?raw=true

I recommend you upgrade to 0.72.1

You have two options,

have many text files? Then each file will be one map task. Save the entire file (like you're doing) and instead write using rhcollect(filename, data)
using sequence as the output format.
